rows.text: Hehe, look who's back! Good to see you, boss!
rows.speaker: Furion

rows.text: What's with the Fortune Cat look?
This isn't a Fortune Cat look! Boss, look closer... I'm a Guardian Lion!
rows.speaker: Furion

rows.text: You need one on each side, that's the rule! As long as I keep my name card hidden, I'm the perfect statue.
rows.speaker: Furion

rows.text: Actually, just stay like that. You'd make a great fortune gatherer.
Staying still like this is hard work! If you really dig the look, maybe I can perform as a statue for the company's annual party or something...
rows.speaker: Furion

rows.text: I seriously thought you were quitting for a moment.
